## Required correction to the Pro algebra

The response inverts the CF300 regulator scalar in its displayed derivation.
For the observed lower-left block

```text
A10 = q B,  q = P/eps^2,
P = (2 eps-1)(3 eps-1)(3 eps-2),
Anew = G^-1 A G,
G = diag(I20, t I2),
```

the lower-left block transforms as `t^-1 A10`.  Therefore the unique scalar
that gives `eps B` is

```text
t = q/eps = P/eps^3,
t^-1 q = eps.
```

The Pro response instead prints `t = eps/q = eps^3/P` and then incorrectly
simplifies `t^-1 q` to `eps`; in fact that choice gives `q^2/eps`.  That part
must not be copied into code or a certificate.  The existing Codex V3/V4
continuation uses the correct `P/eps^3` orientation.  With the correct
orientation, `Jnew = G^-1 Jold` gives
`Jnew[21:22] = eps^3/P Jold[21:22]`, while recovering the old normalization
multiplies by `P/eps^3`; the response's practical warning that downstream
series depth may need three extra orders is consequently still relevant, but
its displayed basis formulas are reversed.
